  "script": "This is why you don't bring your angry dad to an NBA game. NBA mascots have been trolling fans forever. They even let him celebrate with the giant check before taking it away. But some mascots take it way too far, like when this fan found a mascot sitting in his seat and asked him to move. The mascot acted offended and got the entire section to spray him with silly string. But the craziest one was Jazz Bear spraying a bald fan and ruining his beer.
